com.miui.msa.global.description: MIUI System Ads (MSA). Global advertising and commercial recommendation daemon in Xiaomi HyperOS/MIUI. Disabling it removes system-wide banner ads across native apps.

com.miui.analytics.description: Xiaomi Analytics & Telemetry service. Tracks usage behavior, app launches, and crash metrics in the background and uploads them to Xiaomi servers.

com.samsung.android.game.gos.description: Samsung Game Optimizing Service (GOS). Background service that throttles CPU/GPU performance and collects gaming telemetry.

com.samsung.android.app.spage.description: Samsung Free / Samsung News home screen feed. Preloaded content aggregator and sponsored news cards.

com.facebook.services.description: Meta App Manager & Background Services preinstalled on many OEM devices even when Facebook is not installed. Runs background update checks and telemetry.

com.facebook.appmanager.description: Preloaded Meta privileged installer daemon capable of silently updating Meta apps without Google Play Store.

com.android.stk.description: SIM Toolkit (STK). Legacy carrier menu system often used by cellular providers to push promotional flash messages and paid value-added services.

com.verizon.mips.services.description: My Verizon Services. Carrier background diagnostics, billing telemetry, and account management daemon.

com.google.android.apps.tachyon.description: Google Meet (formerly Duo). Preinstalled video calling app; safe to disable if you use another video calling service.

com.google.android.feedback.description: Google Market Feedback Agent. Collects bug reports and diagnostic telemetry for Google Mobile Services.

com.google.android.adservices.api.description: Android Privacy Sandbox / AdServices API. Manages on-device advertising topics and ad attribution.

com.heytap.market.description: OPPO / Realme / OnePlus App Market. Secondary OEM app store that sends frequent promotional push notifications.

com.android.chrome.description: Google Chrome browser. Safe to disable only if you already have an alternative browser (such as Firefox or Brave) installed and Android System WebView active.

com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.description: Google App, Discover feed, and Google Assistant voice trigger. Disabling removes the Discover feed and voice assistant hotword detection.

com.samsung.android.bixby.agent.description: Samsung Bixby Voice Assistant. Disabling removes Bixby voice wake-up and routines integration.

com.android.egg.description: Android Version Easter Egg inside Settings > About Phone. Completely safe to disable.

com.android.printspooler.description: Android Print Spooler service. Disabling breaks direct wireless printing from the phone.

com.google.android.gms.description: Google Play Services. Core framework for push notifications, FIDO2 passkeys, location APIs, and Google Play apps. Disabling breaks many third-party apps.

com.android.systemui.description: Android System UI (status bar, notification shade, lock screen, navigation bar). Disabling causes an immediate unusable black screen.

com.android.phone.description: Core Telephony & Radio interface. Disabling breaks cellular connectivity, emergency calls, and can cause a continuous crash loop.
